finding.summary: load_config error handling only catches SystemExit. If load_config is changed to raise exceptions instead of calling sys.exit(), errors will not be caught and will propagate as unhandled exceptions.
finding.fix: Catch a broader exception base class (e.g., Exception) or check load_config's actual error behavior and handle both SystemExit and specific exceptions it may raise.

label: false_positive
label_reason: any other exception from load_config propagates to call_api's `except Exception`, which returns it as a Promptfoo error (harness_error).
notes: finding.line moved 43 -> 57: at raised_sha fee8a9a the `except SystemExit` around load_config is at agent_provider.py:57 (43 is the SqliteSaver line); the review cited the wrong line.
